description: brain.mjs:158 adds a new CLI flag, `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, to the `claude -p` child process spawned by `thinkClaudeP` for the human-funded claude-p brain path. This is a security-relevant behavioral change (the child now runs with all interactive permission gating disabled) that is not described anywhere in behavioral-spec.md or verification-architecture.md — REQ-009 is scoped exclusively to adding a wall-clock timeout ('二段階...で終了させ...明示的なタイムアウトエラーを返す'). behavioral-spec.md's own No-Functional-Requirements section explicitly promises the opposite: '**No regression**: この feature は既存の runtime/loop/index.mjs / brain.mjs の正常系の挙動...を変更しない。REQ-009 は thinkClaudeP にタイムアウトを追加するだけであり、それ以外の分岐・フォールバック挙動は不変とする' (behavioral-spec.md:423-426). Adding a permission-skip flag to the child invocation is exactly the kind of 'それ以外の...挙動' this NFR forbids touching, yet it was added in the same diff with no REQ-ID, no dedicated test (think-claude-p-timeout.test.mjs only asserts timeout/kill behavior via CLAUDE_BIN fixtures, never asserts which flags are passed to the real `claude` binary), and no adversary review of its own security implications.
requiredFix: Either (a) revert this flag from this feature's diff and land it as its own spec'd, tested, separately-reviewed change, or (b) add an explicit REQ to behavioral-spec.md documenting and justifying `--dangerously-skip-permissions` for the claude-p brain path, with a dedicated test asserting the flag is present and an explicit statement that the No-regression NFR does not apply to it.
